subject: general
question: Who among the following applied European theatrical techniques to Indian Classical dance with folk and tribal dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uday Shankar, **an Indian dancer and choreographer, gained renown for melding **European theatrical techniques **with Indian classical, folk, and tribal dance forms.
 
• He introduced this innovative style, which he initially termed** "Hi-dance,"** garnering attention in India, Europe, and the United States during the 1920s.
 
• Beginning his formal artistic education in **Mumbai in 1917,** Shankar was exposed to a diverse array of dance forms, including Indian classical, folk, and ballet, during his time in Europe.
 
• He coined the term "Hi-dance" to describe his fusion style, later evolving it into "Modern Dance."
 
• In 1965, he established the Uday Shankar Centre for Dance in Kolkata, contributing to the promotion and preservation of dance heritage.
 
• Shankar's contributions to the field of dance were recognized with prestigious accolades, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship** in 1962 and the** Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian honor, bestowed upon him in 1971.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Guru Bipin Singha** is recognized as the pioneer of Manipuri Dance.
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj **was an Indian dancer, composer, singer, and exponent of the Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance in India.
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a legendary Indian classical dancer, guru, and exponent of Odissi dance, credited with the revival and popularization of this classical dance form in the 20th century.
